scope: Optimistic cost estimate using frozen full-prefix gold counts; no quantized solver, convergence, or speedup claim

protocol.control_order: seeded permutation separately for each repeat
protocol.candidate_prefix: Actual ordinary compact-RP PCG20, with normalized p stored as float32
protocol.candidate_setup: One A[x20,Z] batch supplies true prefix residual, AZ, and Z.T AZ
protocol.candidate_continuation: Gold remaining iterations times measured A[t,Z] cost; no augmented solve executed
protocol.candidate_verification: Charge every verification product recorded by the gold continuation
protocol.power_construction: Initial two-pass Gaussian, then refine its factor range for2 and4 additional passes
protocol.matched_rank: Largest compact factor fitting base+float32 Z+float64 coarse core

memory.operator_arrays: retained state + live input + live output + one row_kernel; block is deleted before next allocation
memory.candidate_arrays: compact base + float32 Z + float64 E + float64 packed[t,Z] + float64[At,AZ] + row_kernel
memory.static_arrays: compact factor (or none) + float64 input_vector + float64 output_vector + row_kernel
memory.scope: Exact operator-buffer arrays and conservative constructor envelope; common X/b, Python allocator state and process RSS are not per-method peak certificates
